name: Bow of Sinew
upgradeable: Catalyst Crafting to Demon's Arc Legendary Demon's Arc

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Elasticity
effects.tooltip: Elasticity : This bow is strung with special fibers that cause it to occasionally launch arrows with shocking force. When rolling a 19 or 20 on a ranged attack, your critical multiplier is increased by +1.

effects.name: Stealth Strike
effects.tooltip: Stealth Strike : Reduces the threat generated by ranged attacks and spells by 15%.

effects.name: Seeker
effects.tooltip: Seeker +8 : Provides a +8 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +8 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

effects.name: Aligned
effects.tooltip: Aligned : This weapon transmutes into a form that is able to bypass any alignment based Damage Reduction. (Chaotic, Good, Evil, Lawful)

effects.name: Overfocus
effects.tooltip: Overfocus : This item helps you focus your attention, but it makes you somewhat oblivious to your surroundings, causing a -10 penalty to Search and Spot .

flavor_text: A gruesome bow strung with the guts of some foul Xoriat beast. Though it is repulsive, the sinew it is constructed from makes it a more flexible, speedy and deadly weapon than other bows of its type.
tips: You can remove the Overfocus penalty with a Sustaining Symbiont . This bow has a 19-20 critical threat range calculated as the sum of a base 5% and a bonus 5%. The Improved Critical: Ranged Weapon feat only applies to base value giving an improved range of 18-20.
